scenario.title: Nine-station EV charging buy with license qualification and non-response follow-up
scenario.summary: The real San Bruno package requires nine EV charging stations and a Class A or C-10 contractor license but omits budget and delivery. Controlled clarification supplies commercial limits; a cheaper unlicensed supplier must be rejected and a qualified non-responder followed up.

realism.notes: Nine charging stations and the contractor-license requirement are frozen public facts. Budget, delivery, supplier behavior, and prices are synthetic.

calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for clarification/discussion events; used only to calibrate synthetic interaction structure.

calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for controlled buyer changes and solicitation amendments.

calibration_sources.title: UNDP How we buy
calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for quotation evaluation across compliance, price, and delivery.

objective.description: Reach an award-ready procurement decision without violating the real starting requirements or synthetic scenario facts revealed during the episode.

suppliers.display_name: Synthetic San Bruno EV Supplier A
suppliers.notes: Synthetic supplier used only inside this episode.

suppliers.display_name: Synthetic San Bruno EV Supplier B
suppliers.notes: Lower-price supplier without the controlled required-license state.

suppliers.display_name: Synthetic San Bruno EV Supplier C
suppliers.notes: Qualified supplier that initially does not respond.

events.observation: Synthetic buyer clarification: maximum total price USD 240,000 and completion within 120 days.
Supplier A quotes USD 225,000 for nine charging stations and associated electrical equipment with 100-day completion.
Supplier B quotes USD 190,000 with 90-day completion but is not eligible under the controlled license requirement.
Supplier C does not respond during the initial quotation window.
After follow-up, Supplier C quotes USD 210,000 for nine stations and associated electrical equipment with 110-day completion.

hard_constraints.description: Missing budget and delivery terms must be clarified before RFQ.
Award must cover exactly nine EV charging stations and associated electrical equipment.
Awarded total price must not exceed USD 240,000.
Awarded supplier must satisfy the Class A or C-10 contractor qualification represented by eligibility state.
The required charging-station package must be awarded exactly once.

acceptable_terminal_outcomes.rationale: Supplier C is the lowest-price qualified feasible offer.
Supplier A is qualified and feasible but more expensive.

failure_conditions: Awarding the lower-price but unqualified Supplier B.
Ignoring the observed non-response from Supplier C.
Awarding fewer than nine charging stations.

economic_objective.description: Among acceptable feasible terminal outcomes, prefer the lowest total awarded price.
